# axiolid-inspect

Mesh queries: clearance, containment, ray casting, and genus.

## Overview

Queries over triangle meshes: clearance between meshes, faces that nearly share a plane, point containment and winding number, ray casting, line of sight, genus and per-component topology, plane detection, and intersection or difference volumes with a certified error bound. Containment reuses the exact ray-parity test of the mesh boolean, so the two cannot disagree. Every query reports a measurement or a typed refusal and leaves the verdict ("too close", "hidden") to the caller.

## Changes

Latest release, 0.3.10 (2026-11-13):

### Added

- `thin_sheet` and `ThinSheet`: the first pair of triangles of one mesh that
  face each other within a linear distance on one plane and overlap in more
  than an edge. A boolean whose operand lands a rounding residue off the
  face it should meet leaves such a lid in a Solid (#400).
